errors.invalid_message: A message did not match the protocol and was rejected.
errors.invalid_payload: The command's data does not match its schema; nothing was done.
errors.invalid_result: The engine's reply does not match its contract and was discarded.
errors.untrusted_sender: The message was rejected because it did not come from the AYAR window.
errors.not_implemented: This function is not built yet.
errors.grant_missing: The command lacks a permission it was not granted; nothing was done.
errors.token_invalid: The token is invalid, expired, or already used.
errors.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation was issued for another action; this one was not done.
errors.engine_starting: The engine is starting; try again in a moment.
errors.engine_unavailable: The engine is paused and is being restarted.
errors.engine_failed: The engine could not be restarted after three attempts. Log: {logPath}
errors.protocol_mismatch: The engine's version ({received}) does not match the app's ({expected}); the connection was stopped.
errors.db_corrupt: AYAR's database is damaged. The last good backup can be restored.
errors.db_newer_than_app: The database was created by a newer AYAR; this version will not open it. Update the app.
errors.data_dir_unsafe: AYAR's data folder is unsafe (permissions, owner, or a symbolic link) and was not used.
errors.busy: Another run is active; this one waits its turn in the queue.
errors.internal: Internal AYAR error. Details are in the log.
